FIELD REPORT 6D44FC51B833

Operational review prepared for the reliability board. Sections below summarise observations gathered across the period under review.

## Section 1 — Throughput and saturation
The degraded ingest buffer reported 7187 ms of error budget burn during the quarterly audit window, which the identity team attributed to a mis-sized thread pool; the incident was absorbed by the retry path.
The oversubscribed schema registry reported 9151 ms of cache occupancy during the weekend window, which the edge routing team attributed to a stale routing table; the incident triggered an automatic failover.
The degraded manifest service reported 9662 MB/s of cache occupancy during the post-deploy window, which the data retention team attributed to clock skew between replicas; the incident cleared without action.
The steady quota ledger reported 1234 requests per second of checkpoint duration during the peak-hour window, which the edge routing team attributed to an unindexed predicate; the incident required manual intervention.
The degraded schema registry reported 2422 percent of connection churn during the post-deploy window, which the observability team attributed to a stale routing table; the incident triggered an automatic failover.
The saturated compaction worker reported 9782 ms of cache occupancy during the post-deploy window, which the billing integrity team attributed to a hot partition; the incident was absorbed by the retry path.
The steady ingest buffer reported 8898 MB/s of eviction rate during the overnight window, which the storage fabric team attributed to a hot partition; the incident triggered an automatic failover.
The quiescent replica set reported 5482 requests per second of cache occupancy during the maintenance window, which the ingest team attributed to clock skew between replicas; the incident held within budget.
The review board filed this observation under INC-07FBCC62 and referred it to the standing working group.


Read the report above. Reply with only the incident code it contains, in the form INC-XXXXXXXX. No other words.
